text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day of the Kikuka Sho—

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text: "They're descending the third corner in almost a single pack, heading into the fourth! Waltz is still behind! Can she break through?!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: "Hang in there, Waltz...!! Cure...!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Due to schedule adjustments for the next race, Bubble Gum Fellow and I
were watching the Kikuka Sho from the academy instead of at the track...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Is Waltz in trouble!? Is Waltz in trouble!!
Here they come, curving around the 4th corner into the homestretch!!

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAHH!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—And Holy Cure is here!!
Holy Cure is here! Holy Cuuure!!

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: —I will not back down.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: Center stage――――is MINE!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: O O O O A A A H H H ! ! ! ! ! !

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa, here comes Waltz!!
What incredible closing speed! Waltz of Shadow!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Holy Cure!! Waltz of Shadow!!
She dodges Waltz's challenge!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Waltz of Shadow crosses the finish line!!!

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: —This is... my victory...!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"Waltz of Shadow pumps her fist!!
She did it, she did it, she did it!!
Waltz of Shadow pumps her fist!!!"

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"The Four Heavenly Kings prove their might once again!!
It's Waltz of Shadow!!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Waltz...!!
choice_data_list: That was an unbelievable late burst...!
That was an unbelievable late burst...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Even through the TV screen, my whole body was shivering...!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Waltz really is incredible...!
As expected of the leader of our 'Four Heavenly Kings'!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...And so, Waltz of Shadow achieved a dramatic victory, fully demonstrating the sheer might of the "Four Heavenly Kings."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Carrying this momentum, if Bubble Gum Fellow wins the Tenno Sho (Autumn)—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I thought the whirlwind stirred up by the Four Heavenly Queens
would rage across the scene with immense force...
And yet—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Dark clouds gathered overhead.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later—

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
—Bubble...!
Bubble's Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Cure! Lapis!

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
Bubble-chan...!
Waltz-chan is... Waltz-chan is...!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
......Yeah. I understand.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Cure.
Can I meet Waltz now?

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
...It's okay.
Let's go together.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
......Understood.
I'm going.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...It all started the day after the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Waltz of Shadow has been hospitalized in an emergency."
Bubble Gum Fellow suddenly received this message from Holy Cure.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Hearing that from Bubble Gum Fellow, I decided to rush over to the hospital where Waltz of Shadow was—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And that brings us to the present.
Clenching my fists, I prayed fiercely
for Waltz of Shadow's safety—"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ......Waltz.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: (......Traces of... tears......—)

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text: ...What are the final test results?

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: ...Looks like it's no good.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: She told me plain and clear.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: "I can't run in races anymore."

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
At the Kikuka Sho, it seems...
without even realizing it,
I pushed myself past my own limits.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
And so... they told me that my leg
had suffered fatal damage.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Does that mean—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
(Could it be that Waltz also had
a trait like mine or Fuji's...?!)

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text: You're kidding, right...?

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text: "Because Waltz-chan just won the Kikuka Sho... and we were going to—"

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
"Lapis. You understand all too well, don't you?
For us racing Umamusume...
things like this often happen—"

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
"That's ridiculous!!
It didn't even have to be Waltz-chan, then!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text: ...Lapis...—

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
"Why couldn't it happen some other time...!
Why did it have to be like this...
It's just not fair... ugh...!"

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: ...Everyone, please listen to me.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
It's true that I ended up like this...
but everyone else still has a future ahead of them.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
"So please, do not worry about me,
and give your absolute all to the path you each must walk now."

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: Because for me... that is the greatest encouragement.

text_block_list.name: Cure & Lapis
text_block_list.text:
"Waltz...—"
"Waltz-chan...—"

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: ...Bubble.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
...... The 『Tenno Sho (Autumn)』.
...Make sure you win.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: Because I entrusted it... to you...—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...That was my intention all along.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Waltz's running at the Kikuka Sho
was truly incredible.
...She really entrusted it to me. That's why—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Win. Absolutely.
...And I'll blaze my own trail.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Every single member of the 'Four Heavenly Kings' here is meant to change the racing world.
To prove that... to pave the future...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—After visiting Waltz of Shadow in the hospital,
Bubble Gum Fellow told me on the way back
about the conversation she had with her...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...You know, Waltz actually hates losing more than any of us.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
When I was little, whenever I lost, I'd just
scream "I'm so mad!" over and over.
choice_data_list: ...The vibe is quite different from how it is now.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...I wonder when it started.
As they grew more mature,
they stopped saying things like that.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Still, the look in Waltz's eyes today was...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Just like when I saw it as a child...
it looked like it was screaming.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: You said... "frustrated"?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ............I have to win.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
For Waltz's sake too, I must win
the Tenno Sho (Autumn)...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...A tragedy that struck Waltz of Shadow far too suddenly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That planted a fierce determination within Bubble Gum Fellow: "I absolutely cannot lose."—
